fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on high electric and power bills attributed to Florida Power & Light, concerns about safety and speed of Coral Gables rapid transit streetcars and related automobile fatalities, and discussion of gambling and race track enforcement. Also covers local civic matters including Community Chest fundraising and a grand jury recommendation regarding facilities for the care of the insane at the county stockade, alongside local columns, letters to the editor, advertisements, and legal notices.
